tasks.title: Position error from geometry
tasks.solution: σ_hor ≈ HDOP · σ_UERE: geometry multiplies the measurement error. The same receiver next to a house wall with HDOP 3 is off three times as much as in an open field.

tasks.title: Error from an uncompensated delay
tasks.solution: During the delay the aircraft travels v·t. Hence GPS1_DELAY_MS: the EKF matches the measurement against the state in the past, not the current one.
